newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: IMF mission to conduct Philippine review.
newsitem.headline: IMF mission to conduct Philippine review.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund (IMF) mission will arrive this week to conduct a two-week review on Philippine economic affairs, an IMF official said.

"The review will cover a whole range of economic policy issues, including budgetary, monetary and external as well as developments in national accounts and prices," the IMF's resident representative in Manila David Nellor said.

The review, which will start on Friday, is deemed crucial to the government's bid to exit from the IMF-supervised programme and obtain the seal of good housekeeping. This is the IMF's second review of the Philippines this year.
The three-year IMF programme for the Philippines ends in June, 1997. -- Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 fax 8176267
